stem: Voltmarkt's margin bridge from Q2 to Q3 shows price +€5,000, cost -€40,000, volume +€3,000 and mix +€2,000, with no new or discontinued products. Gross margin fell by €30,000. What is the main reason?

options.text: Unit costs rose, and prices barely moved to cover them

Voltmarkt cut its selling prices between Q2 and Q3
